Do this:
1. Read CLAUDE.md (the rulebook rules), the change set, and the files of the affected scheme(s): mh.ladki_bahin.
2. Apply every change in the change set, following CLAUDE.md exactly:

   - condition change: set `valid_until` on the old condition to the day before 2025-04-01, and add a new condition with the same id and `valid_from: 2025-04-01`.

5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and fix problems until it prints `0 failed` with no PROBLEM lines.
6. Do not run git. Do not edit files outside schemes/, parameters/, tests/, sources/, glossary/, schema/ and CHANGELOG.md.

Finish with a short summary of what you changed and the final test result.

e='''## 15 March 2025: Ladki Bahin monthly benefit raised to Rs 2,100 (from 1 April 2025)

- English: From 1 April 2025 the monthly benefit rises from Rs 1,500 to Rs 2,100 for each eligible woman. All other eligibility rules stay the same, including the Rs 1,500 limit on benefits from other schemes; a woman getting less than Rs 2,100 from another scheme is paid the difference.
- हिंदी: 1 अप्रैल 2025 से हर पात्र महिला का मासिक लाभ 1,500 रुपये से बढ़कर 2,100 रुपये हो गया है। अन्य सभी पात्रता नियम पहले जैसे हैं, जिनमें अन्य योजनाओं से मिलने वाले लाभ की 1,500 रुपये की सीमा भी शामिल है; अन्य योजना से 2,100 रुपये से कम पाने वाली महिला को अंतर की रक्कम मिलेगी।
- मराठी: 1 एप्रिल 2025 पासून प्रत्येक पात्र महिलेला दरमहा मिळणारी रक्कम 1,500 रुपयांवरून 2,100 रुपये झाली आहे. इतर सर्व पात्रता निकष पूर्वीप्रमाणेच आहेत, इतर योजनांमधून मिळणाऱ्या लाभाची 1,500 रुपयांची मर्यादा यासह; इतर योजनेतून 2,100 रुपयांपेक्षा कमी लाभ घेणाऱ्या महिलेला फरकाची रक्कम मिळेल.
- Source: [GR 92e236664737c118](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/92e236664737c118.pdf)

The Ladki Bahin monthly benefit now rises from Rs 1,500 to Rs 2,100 from 2025-04-01. `python -m niyam_rulebook test` prints `31 passed, 0 failed`, with no PROBLEM lines.

- **Parameter:** I added a `2025-04-01` value of 2100 to `parameters/mh/ladki_bahin/monthly_benefit.yaml`. It cites `gr-92e236664737c118`, page 1, clause 1, with the Marathi quote and its English translation. The older value is untouched. The benefit formula already uses this parameter, so I changed no scheme conditions.
- **Ambiguity:** The change set asks whether the Rs 1,500 other-scheme limit should also rise. I kept `other_scheme_max_inr` at 1500, following clause 3 ("all other criteria... remain as before"). The top-up is therefore `max(0, 2100 − other scheme amount)`. If the government meant the cap to rise too, that needs a new dated value.

  - **2025-04-01 and 2025-04-02:** the benefit is Rs 2,100.
  - **Other-scheme amounts of 1,499, 1,500 and 1,501 on 2025-04-01:** the woman gets Rs 601, then Rs 600, then is ineligible.
